leftEvidence.title: Humanity is created male and female

points.label: People
points.left: Humanity is named collectively as male and female.
points.right: The narrative names man and woman as distinct persons.

points.label: Unity
points.left: Both receive the human blessing and commission.
points.right: The passage culminates in one-flesh language.

points.label: Voice
points.left: God speaks about and blesses humanity.
points.right: The man speaks in recognition of the woman.

payload.posture: Let the two passages provide different scales of description.

rightEvidence.title: Woman is formed, recognized, and joined to man

payload.tension: Genesis 1 presents male and female together within the human commission, while Genesis 2 narrates formation, recognition, and one flesh at close range.
payload.title: Male and female / one flesh
